adapterBoundary.nativeWrites: native preview, exact operation allow-list, execute, exact confirm and durable journal; ambiguous deletes refused

discovery.help:
checkpoint-axi email search [--limit <n>]
Artium manages region, client ID and secret. Writes require administrator-enabled exact operations and native preview, --execute and exact --confirm. Upload private JSON with --input. Use artium-axi download for authenticated email and attachment saving with host-owned confirmation; ordinary downloads and local configuration are blocked.
